statement.essentials: Tumours in the inner part of the gland are less common, are often larger when found, and their operations carry more complications and more recurrence.
statement.anatomy: In a single-centre series, deep-lobe pleomorphic adenomas were larger than superficial-lobe ones, were more often found by chance on imaging, and had more complications (mainly temporary facial weakness) and more recurrence.
statement.clinical: Complications occurred in 41% of 147 deep-lobe and 30% of 222 superficial-lobe pleomorphic adenomas (p = 0.025); recurrence in 4.1% and 0.4% (p = 0.016); median size 2.6 cm and 2.0 cm.
